name: Why are bathroom remodel quotes so different, and how do I know which one is actually fair?

mainEntity.name: Why are bathroom remodel quotes so different, and how do I know which one is actually fair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom renovation cost depends less on the room’s size than on the scope: finishes, fixture quality, plumbing relocation, electrical changes, cabinetry, tile complexity, waterproofing, ventilation, and repairs behind finished surfaces. A San Diego homeowner should compare complete scopes rather than isolated line-item prices. Elite Remodeling & Design combines design development and construction coordination, so the comparison should show what is included in both stages. Key factors include: - Keeping or changing the existing layout - Standard versus custom fixtures and storage - Permit and inspection coordination - Allowance for concealed damage. Ask each contractor to separate labor, materials, allowances, exclusions, and possible change conditions. A lower initial number may not be better if it omits design, protection, ventilation, or necessary rough work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quotes vary because layout changes, tile labor, cabinetry, ventilation, permits, waterproofing, fixtures, and concealed repairs may be included differently. Compare detailed scopes, allowances, exclusions, schedules, and change-order procedures—not just the total price.
